reviews.title: Unprofessional & inferior service response
reviews.text: I bought an air ticket from Singapore to Yangon on 24 Mar 2023. There were four emails with two different booking reference sent by Mai Air & their payment counterpart to me on 24 Mar 2023, between 1212hrs to 1428hrs. The option cancellation email was the last one that came in on 24 Mar 2023, 1428hrs. As a consumer, I am confused with the content, booking ID difference etc. Hence, I had wrote to Mai Air on 24 Mar 2023, 1545hrs & 1811hrs respectively to clarify (not to assume) on this matter. The flight departure date was on 28 Mar 2023. There was no response from Mai Air from 24 Mar 2023 to 29 Mar 2023, Mai Air first response came on 30 Mar 2023 two days after the flight departure date. When I demand for refund, Mai Air simply use the term & condition of the air ticket upon me. The confusion, slow email response and lack of clarity were never part of their mistake. Re-CONSIDER & think TWICE!!! If you want to buy air ticket from Mai Air.

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: The airline was comfortable. We had an early morning flight and breakfast was provided in a paper container and surprisingly good. The airplane was clean and comfortable. Although not directly related to this review about the airline, there are some important information about airports in Myanmar I would like to share. Myanmar airports in general are very chaotic. Although delays are for local flights are extremely common (unless you are on the first flight out in the morning) it is still better to arrive slightly early. Except for the international terminal in Yangon airport which is similar to most other worldwide airports, the local airports are considerably smaller. The waiting rooms at local airports are extremely crowded. Airport food is ridiculously expensive. An ice-cream cone in one local airport costs US $5! Most important of all, there are NO OVERHEAD BOARD DISPLAY showing flight departures. All you get is someone walking into the crowded waiting room holding a sign showing the airline that is boarding at the moment. Then all the passengers rush forward to squeeze through the small exit door to the tarmac. Make sure you check with the agent at door before leaving the waiting room. Monks and his traveling companion receive priority boarding. Families with young children will have to fend for themselves.

Drinks are limited, but that is probably a great idea - if you wanted to you could try Myanmar red and white wine. I settled for Coke Light. A very pleasant experience.

reviews.title: Airline (MAI) canceled flight 4 days before. . .zero refund for major inconvenience
reviews.text: In March, 2018, I purchased a ticket on Vayama.com for a Myanmar Airways International (MAI) round-trip flight from Mandalay to Nyaung U for flight 8M4232 at 9:40 AM on June 21st. I did not purchase a one-way ticket. I paid for a round-trip ticket. The hotel I was staying at in Myanmar did not have good WiFi, and I did not receive an email dated June 17th. The email was a notification that my 9:40 AM flight on June 21st was canceled and rescheduled for 17:50 (5:50 PM). I left my hotel at around 7:10 AM for the hour-long drive to Mandalay Airport, and I arrived at the airport at 8:10 AM. At that time, I was notified that the MAI flight would not leave until 5:50 PM. Initially, the MAI representative told me that my only options were to wait at the airport until 5:50 PM (about a 10-hour wait), or I could pay $100 USD for a private taxi. After about 45 minutes, the airline representative told me I could take a shared bus for about $15 USD, but it would take 4 hours to get to Bagan. At that time, I asked if I could still use my ticket for the return trip from Bagan back to Mandalay, and I asked about a refund. She (the MAI representative) said I would need to contact the company that sold me the ticket (Vayama.com) to request a refund. I was assured everything would be fine. So, instead of arriving at 10:10 AM, I paid for the bus ticket and arrived in Bagan around 5:00 PM. Basically, I missed a full day of sightseeing in Bagan because MAI decided to cancel the 9:40 AM flight they sold to me. The MAI representative told me that it was unusual for there to be morning flights from Mandalay to Bagan during the slow season. I requested a partial refund for the portion of the ticket that was canceled, but MAI said they could not help since they did not sell the ticket to me. Also, Vayama.com said their policy would not allow any kind of refund because I took the return flight from Bagan to Mandalay. If MAI is going to sell tickets for morning flights from Mandalay to Bagan during the slow season (June), their customers would be less angry if they actually honored the tickets they sold (flying customers from Mandalay to Bagan in the AM) or at least provided partial refunds when they cancel half of the ticket.

reviews.title: Good overall flight, by food not to my taste desires
reviews.text: I selected Myanmar Airways for my flight from Yangon to Guangzhou primarily on direct service, time of day, and price. As on my past flight on MAI, the overall service from check-in and throughout the flight was very good. The onboard service was very friendly, and the on-board food was good. Flight attendants are multi-lingual and very friendly. I was very happy with the economy class, window seat. The legroom and width were average size and good enough for me. Economy class cabin was nice and clean. The meal was not good for my taste needs. It was probably average airline food for Asians, by not to my Westerner’s stomach desires. Oh well, this is lilely a Westerner-Asian food issue, because when I go to Asian restaurants with my Chinese friends, they often select foods which I have no desire to try, and they prefer those foods over the western-world foods I like. The flight left and landed about 15 minutes late, which is fairly good for any flight.

reviews.title: Comfortable three-hour flight & good service
reviews.text: I selected Myanmar Airways for my flight primarily because of the direct service, time of day, and price. The overall service from check-in and throughout the flight was very good. The onboard service was very friendly, and the on-board food was good. Flight attendants are multi-lingual and very friendly. I was very happy with the economy class, window seat 16F. The legroom and width were average size and good enough for me. Economy class cabin was nice and clean. The 3 hour and 5 minutes scheduled direct flight from Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport (CAN) to Yangon International Airport (RGN) left and landed within a few minutes of schedule. The flight was on an Airbus A319 aircraft.

And he was complaining that I can only able to take one bag, either cabin bag or camera backpack. So far I had taking the low budget airlines, they do allow one cabin bag and backpack together. Why this airline not able to do so? It was took almost 30min at his counter and finally he let me go. It is really creating the bad image and service of this airline. I may need to consider on my future trips not to take this airline.
